Variants.Content: Noble cavalry and local guards share valleys and passes. Campaigns need estates and grain; war with Lazica also affects coastal supply.

Kartlian noble cavalry and local guards share valleys and passes. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Lazican war also affects coastal supply.
